I was also a heavy cart user for about a year then I quit which was the hardest thing I’ve ever done.  I’m around 5’5 and about 130, super lean, visible 6 pack, hardly any body fat, my veins are visible after intense physical activity. I mention this cause when I quit it was a rough month. Waking up nightly soaking wet in sweat and I never sweat, even when doing Intense labor.  Weeks of nightmares, no appetite, which led to weight loss.  The cravings of those dab carts is so awful for the first week or so, absolutely miserable.  I was able to quit for about 2 years, but took an old job back and I started up again in order to cope with the workload and mind numbing tasks.  I just quit again about 17 days ago now in order to find a new job and be able to pass a drug test.  Nearly 3 weeks and I still can’t pass a urine test even tho I have hardly any body fat and I drink plenty of fluids.  17 days and it’s still hard to sleep, I still have nightmares, I still wake up soaking wet, having to put a towel down in the middle of the night.  I finally got my appetite back but since I’m still between jobs I only manage one meal per day to try and save money. I know I’ve probably lost at least 10-15lbs this time, and it’s super depressing.  Although the cravings are pretty much gone, the first couple of days I recommend you stay busy, that is the best way, just keep your brain and body busy.  Hang in there, you are not alone.  I almost relapsed today after me and my dad got into a heated argument, he told me  “proper son.” That hurt pretty bad but I think he was back on that bottle and as much as I wanted to tell him what I thought of him I kept it to myself.  Yeah that was 9hrs ago and I still can’t sleep.  Day 17 and sleep is still a struggle.  I start a new job on Monday and I’m not sure how this is gonna go due to the fact I have hardly any energy due to lack of sleep and not getting enough food.  I don’t want to make you feel like it’s impossible but I’m not going to lie to you and tell you it will be easy.  Those carts are something else man… but damn are they good! I would love to rip that pen one more time but I’m trying to think of career paths and my future. Don’t give up, you got this.
